parameters.name: ApiKey
parameters.description: The API key for the model service.

parameters.name: BaseUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the upstream service.

parameters.name: InputCostPointsPerMillion
parameters.description: The billing cost for input, measured in points per one million tokens.

parameters.description: The billing cost for output, measured in points per one million tokens.

parameters.name: RequestCostPoints

parameters.description: The model service provider. The example value `bailian` is a pinyin-based identifier that corresponds to the product name Model Studio.
